sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Impossible Car Stunts - Mega Car Ramp is a racing game that challenges you to navigate through impossible tracks, performing insane stunts and acrobatic maneuvers along the way. The game's controls are intuitive and easy to pick up, making it accessible to players of all skill levels.

To control your car, you'll use a combination of keyboard buttons. The left and right arrow keys steer the car, while the up arrow key boosts your speed and the down arrow key slows you down. The space bar reverses the car, and the shift key brakes. With practice, you'll be able to master these controls and perform daring stunts with ease.

One of the key features of Impossible Car Stunts - Mega Car Ramp is its nitro boost system. By tapping the nitro button, you can temporarily increase your speed and perform even more impressive stunts. However, be careful not to overuse the nitro, as it can leave you vulnerable to crashes and other hazards.

Overall, the gameplay mechanics in Impossible Car Stunts - Mega Car Ramp are engaging, challenging, and highly addictive. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just starting out, you'll find yourself hooked from the very first level.
